vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Whoa! Did you see that flash in the sky? What is lightning?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: I know! Lightning is a giant dragon, taking a photo! Say cheese! Flash!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Ha ha! Good guess, Leo! But lightning is a giant spark of electricity!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Electricity.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Electricity!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Rumble, rumble... Boom! Eek! That is loud!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: That boom is thunder. And here is our storm rule: when thunder roars, go indoors!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: When thunder roars, go indoors! Come on, everybody, inside!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Phew! Inside, we are safe and cozy. Professor Hoot, how does lightning happen?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Let's find out, with three questions!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Question one. What happens inside a storm cloud?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: A storm cloud is full of tiny bits of ice, and little drops of water.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: The wind tosses them up and down, and they bump, and bump, and bump!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Bump! Bump! Bump!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: All that bumping fills the cloud with electricity. More, and more, and more.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Until it is too full! Then, zap! The electricity jumps out, as a giant spark!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: That's lightning!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Lightning can jump from the cloud down to the ground, or from one cloud, to another cloud!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Look at its shape. Is lightning a straight line, or a zigzag?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: A straight line, like a ruler!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: No, Leo! A zigzag! Zig, zag, zig, zag!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Question two. Can we make a tiny spark, like a baby lightning?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Yes! With a balloon, and a grown-up to help.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Ooh, me! Me! Can I try?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Rub the balloon on your fur, Bobo. Rub, rub, rub!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Rub, rub, rub!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Ha ha! Bobo, your fur is standing up!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Now, hold the balloon on the wall... and let go!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Whoa! It sticks to the wall, all by itself!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: That is electricity too! The same kind as lightning, just teeny, tiny, and safe.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Sometimes it even makes a tiny snap, when you touch a door handle. Snap!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Hee hee! My fur is tickly!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Question three. Why do we see the flash first, and hear the boom after?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Light and sound run a race! Light is super, super fast.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Sound is slower. So the flash wins, and the boom comes last.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: When you see a flash, count until the boom. Let's try!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Flash!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: One...

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Two...

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Three...

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Boom!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Three! The bigger the number, the farther away the storm is.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: But near or far, we stay inside, until the storm is over.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Wow fact! Lightning is super hot. Hotter than the outside of the Sun!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Hotter than the Sun? Wow!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And lightning flashes somewhere on Earth, many, many times, every single second!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's play the storm safety game!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Thunder is booming! Where should we go? Under a big tree, or inside a house?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Under the big tree! It's like an umbrella!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Not quite, Leo! Lightning likes tall things, like trees. We go inside a house!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Can we play in the swimming pool, during a storm?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: No! We get out of the water, and go inside!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Bobo is scared of the boom. What can we do?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: We give him a big hug! Storms are noisy, but inside, we are safe.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Thank you! I feel better now.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Look! The storm is over, and here comes the sunshine!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's remember!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: What is lightning?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: A giant spark of electricity!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Is lightning straight, or a zigzag?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: A zigzag!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: What comes first, the flash, or the boom?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: The flash! Light is faster!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: What did the balloon do to Bobo's fur?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: It made it stand up! Poof!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And when thunder roars...?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Go indoors!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Now, let's say it together!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Lightning is a spark!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: The flash comes first!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: The boom comes last!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: When thunder roars, go indoors!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Your turn! When thunder roars...

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Go indoors! Great job!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Bye bye, friends! Stay safe and cozy!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: See you next time, on Tiny Sparks!
